effect.caverns_and_chasms.subtle.descrip: An effect that hides all potion particles.
lore.spicedcider.wormy_dirt: A patch of dirt teeming with Worms. Breaking it drops several Worms unless mined with Silk Touch. Chickens, Ducks, and Turkeys fed Corn Kernels will go hunting for it.
lore.spicedcider.worm: A wriggly critter dug up from Wormy Dirt or found in Composters. It makes good fishing bait, and can be gilded into a Golden Worm.
lore.spicedcider.golden_worm: A Worm coated in Gold. It makes excellent fishing bait, attracting bites much faster than a plain Worm.
lore.spicedcider.worm_crate: A crate packed with Worms, for compact storage.
lore.spicedcider.golden_worm_crate: A crate packed with Golden Worms, for compact storage.
lore.spicedcider.deposit: A lumpy stone vein found underground that breaks into Geodes. Mine it with Silk Touch to keep the block.
lore.spicedcider.deepslate_deposit: A lumpy deepslate vein found deep underground that breaks into Deepslate Geodes. Mine it with Silk Touch to keep the block.
lore.spicedcider.blackstone_deposit: A lumpy blackstone vein found in the Nether that breaks into Blackstone Geodes. Mine it with Silk Touch to keep the block.
lore.spicedcider.geode: A rock with something inside. Crack it open with a Hammer on a Workstone for Copper, Tin, and Iron nuggets, or Amethyst. Also found in dungeon chests and fished up from underground water.
lore.spicedcider.deepslate_geode: A deepslate rock with something inside. Crack it open with a Hammer on a Workstone for Iron, Lead, and Gold nuggets, or a Rough Diamond Shard.
lore.spicedcider.blackstone_geode: A blackstone rock from the Nether with something inside. Crack it open with a Hammer on a Workstone for Gold nuggets, Cinnabar, Quartz, or a scrap of Infernite. Can be fished up from lava.
lore.spicedcider.tallow: Animal fat rendered from Pork or Beef in a Cooking Pot. Used for frying, Soap, and Candles. Burns in a Furnace.
lore.spicedcider.cast_iron_ingot: A brittle, heavy ingot forged from Iron and Coal. Used for Cauldrons, Hoppers, Minecarts, and other ironmongery.
lore.spicedcider.cast_iron_nugget: A small piece of Cast Iron that can be combined into an ingot.
lore.spicedcider.cast_iron_block: A solid block of Cast Iron.
lore.spicedcider.cast_iron_sheet: A plate of Cast Iron flattened with a Mechanical Press. Used to make Chutes and Cleavers.
lore.spicedcider.fire_striker: A single-use firestarter knapped from Flint. Lights a fire or a Campfire, then crumbles.
lore.spicedcider.grappling_hook: A hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Instead of fishing, the line latches onto blocks so you can reel yourself in. Good for climbing, not for fish.
lore.spicedcider.sticky_grappling_hook: A Grappling Hook coated in slime. It sticks to walls instead of bouncing off them.
lore.spicedcider.flux_hook: A Bronze hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Gives you a larger catch zone in the fishing minigame.
lore.spicedcider.gold_hook: A Gold hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Grants +1 luck while fishing.
lore.spicedcider.heavy_hook: A Steel and Lead hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Favours larger fish, which fight more slowly.
lore.spicedcider.light_hook: A Rose Gold hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Casts much farther, and hooked fish fight more slowly.
lore.spicedcider.double_hook: A Diamond hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Has a chance to catch two fish at once.
lore.spicedcider.prismarite_hook: A Prismarite hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Grants +2 luck when fishing in open ocean.
lore.spicedcider.featherlight_hook: A Valkyrium hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Hooked fish can never escape the minigame.
lore.spicedcider.necromium_hook: A Necromium hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Bait is never used up.
lore.spicedcider.adamantite_hook: An Adamantite hook fitted to a fishing rod at an Angling Table. Allows fishing in Dimensional Tears.
lore.spicedcider.rubber_cable: A flexible cable made from Rubber. It can be strung between fences and walls like a chain.
lore.spicedcider.blast_proof_plating: Gold plates forged with Creeper Spores to absorb blasts. Crafted into Mischief armor.
lore.spicedcider.mischief_helmet: Armor made from Blast-Proof Plating that reduces explosion damage by a quarter. A full set shrugs off explosions entirely, and Piglins ignore its wearer.
lore.spicedcider.mischief_chestplate: Armor made from Blast-Proof Plating that reduces explosion damage by almost a third. A full set shrugs off explosions entirely, and Piglins ignore its wearer.
lore.spicedcider.mischief_leggings: Armor made from Blast-Proof Plating that reduces explosion damage by a quarter. A full set shrugs off explosions entirely, and Piglins ignore its wearer.
lore.spicedcider.mischief_boots: Armor made from Blast-Proof Plating that reduces explosion damage by a fifth. A full set shrugs off explosions entirely, and Piglins ignore its wearer.
lore.spicedcider.infernite_cleaver: A brutal Cleaver upgraded with Infernite. A fully charged swing while standing still sends out a shockwave that knocks back and slows nearby enemies. Mobs slain with it can drop their heads.
lore.spicedcider.latex_bucket: Milky sap tapped from Kapok logs. Pour it into a Basin and press it with a Mechanical Press to set a Block of Rubber, or mix it hot with Sulfur Dust for Rubber.
lore.spicedcider.latex_bottle: Milky sap tapped from Kapok logs with a Tap and a Cauldron. Four bottles fill a Bucket.
lore.spicedcider.chromarine: A vivid prismarine stone that forms reefs on warm ocean floors and in the Prismatic Seep, where Chromatic Brambles take root.
lore.spicedcider.achromarine: A pale prismarine stone that forms reefs on cold and deep ocean floors and in the Prismatic Seep, where Achromatic Brambles take root.
lore.spicedcider.sulfide: A dark mineral crust deposited around hydrothermal vents on the floor of the Abyss.
lore.spicedcider.sulfide_vent: A chimney of Sulfide that rises from hydrothermal vents in the Abyss. Black smoke pours from its top, along with bubbles while underwater.
lore.spicedcider.calcite_vent: A pale Calcite chimney that rises from hydrothermal vents in the Abyss. White smoke pours from its top, along with bubbles while underwater.
lore.spicedcider.tubeworm: A colony of worms living on the floor of the Abyss. They hide in their tubes when a swimming player comes near. Shear the top to collect 4 Red Dye, or use any Dye on them to change their colour. Sheared plumes grow back over time.
lore.spicedcider.budding_prismarine: A Prismarine block found atop the prismarine spires of the Prismatic Seep. Prismarine Buds slowly grow on its sides, in air or water.
lore.spicedcider.small_prismarine_bud: The first stage of a Prismarine Cluster, growing from Budding Prismarine. Only drops itself when mined with Silk Touch.
lore.spicedcider.medium_prismarine_bud: The second stage of a Prismarine Cluster, growing from Budding Prismarine. Only drops itself when mined with Silk Touch.
lore.spicedcider.large_prismarine_bud: The third stage of a Prismarine Cluster, growing from Budding Prismarine. Only drops itself when mined with Silk Touch.
lore.spicedcider.prismarine_cluster: A fully grown crystal from Budding Prismarine. Mining it drops 4 Prismarine Shards.
lore.spicedcider.chromatic_bramble: A colourful underwater shrub that grows on Chromarine reefs. It can only be placed in water.
lore.spicedcider.tall_chromatic_bramble: A tall colourful underwater shrub that grows on Chromarine reefs. It can only be placed in water.
lore.spicedcider.achromatic_bramble: A pale underwater shrub that grows on Achromarine reefs. It can only be placed in water.
lore.spicedcider.tall_achromatic_bramble: A tall pale underwater shrub that grows on Achromarine reefs. It can only be placed in water.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_log: The thin, branching wood of the Cacao Tree. It joins up with neighbouring Cacao Logs and fills out with leaves when surrounded by them.
lore.spicedcider.stripped_cacao_log: A Cacao Log with its bark stripped away by an axe.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_wood: Cacao bark on every side, for building with the branching Cacao shape.
lore.spicedcider.stripped_cacao_wood: Cacao Wood with its bark stripped away by an axe.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_leaves: Leaves of the Cacao Tree. Cacao Pods sprout beneath them over time, or right away with Bone Meal. Drops Cacao Saplings.
lore.spicedcider.cacao_sapling: A plant that grows into a small Cacao Tree, whose leaves grow Cacao Pods.
lore.spicedcider.deepsilt: Fine black sediment that settles on the floor of the Abyss. It falls like sand.
lore.spicedcider.algae: A slimy mat of Algae found on swamp and river beds. Underwater, it spreads onto nearby Sand and Gravel when Kelp grows close by. Bone Meal spreads it faster.
lore.spicedcider.algal_gravel: Gravel overgrown with Algae, found on ocean floors among Kelp. It spreads to nearby Sand and Gravel while underwater near Kelp.
lore.spicedcider.algal_sand: Sand overgrown with Algae, found on ocean floors among Kelp. It spreads to nearby Sand and Gravel while underwater near Kelp.
